entities.summary: The Chongrungsa Buddhist temple is an historic structure located in Ryongsan-ri, Ryokpo-guyok, Pyongyang, North Korea. It dates from the 5th Century and has been extensively excavated and surveyed. It serves as an important example in the study of temple construction in Goguryeo and is a National Treasure of North Korea. Both the pagoda and the temple itself are listed as National Treasures.
